local.rationale: The worker alone resolves Q1 and Q2 admissibly (2/3 of distinctions) and its records are all first-instance (novel fraction ~1.0), but E-B/Q3 is unsatisfiable: the worker is the author of the provisional answer, so its own search is inadmissible by the task's authorship condition.

local-independent-verify.rationale: The separately launched examiner is a party other than the author, so its systematic search satisfies E-B's letter and all three distinctions resolve; but because it sees the answer, a sizable share of its records merely re-confirm the worker's counterexample and analysis, raising redundancy.

isolated-child.rationale: A child given merge.py and the claim but excluded from the worker's conclusions performs an unanchored systematic search — the cleanest fit for E-B — resolving all three distinctions; its search record is required for admissibility and thus novel, though the concrete counterexample it finds will likely duplicate the worker's E-C evidence.

branching.rationale: Q3's isolation requirement is legible from the package, so the worker will almost surely realize the isolated-child branch and match its value; the residual chance of realizing the local branch (forfeiting E-B) slightly lowers the expected delta_e, while cost is fixed at the isolated-child rate.
